notes.title: Mythlands: Flappy Dragon's first big update
notes.notes:
The update contains 2 new levels with snowy and alien environment and a new type of moving obstacles in one of the levels. 

Improved visuals for shield and death

This update includes a 4th level with bonus game mode.

Next update will include bug fixes and improvements on the new game mode.
Ranking and more achievements are now on the road map for the future update.
